summary: Iter37 end-to-end testing of 4 new features: (1) Cross-Border one-pager PDF (GET /api/report/crossborder-pdf) — advisor on client_a1, after cb-save, cb-onepager returns 200 PDF; enterprise tier gets 403; (2) RESP family save — POST /api/plan/education/save with 2 children + family_income=48000 returns ok=true, per_child=[2 entries], combined.projectedValue>0; GET /api/plan/education/saved returns the stored record with 2 children; /report/pdf (full plan) returns 200 PDF (>2KB); client-side one-pager PDF also downloads (data-testid=download-report → The-Nguyen-Household-summary.pdf); (3) OH progressive state tax verified via POST /api/plan/crossborder (us_green_card=true, state=OH, income=120000) → state_tax=2223, 'Progressive state tax'; TX → 0 / 'No state income tax'; NY → progressive >0; UI /crossborder with cb-ca-resident OFF + cb-green-card ON + state=OH shows STATE (OH) $2,223 and 'Progressive state tax' note; TX shows $0 and 'No state income tax'; (4) Enterprise invite_status pill — scott@sweston.ca /enterprise/overview returns households_list with invite_status; after POST /api/enterprise/clients/invite with a fresh email on hid 2648ea35..., the dashboard re-renders row's data-testid=invite-status-<hid> pill with text 'Invite pending'. Regression: /report, /education, /crossborder, /dashboard all load; /report/pdf and client-side jsPDF both succeed; enterprise overview loads. Pytest: 9/9 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter37_onepager_resp_oh_invite.py).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/planning.py enterprise_overview: invite_status detection relies on repo.all_users() scan + must_change_password flag — fine functionally but O(users) per overview call; cache or index by client_id for scale.

routers/education.py: 'existing[0]' upsert replaces only the first existing row — safe today (one plan per household) but if multiple accidentally exist (data drift), later ones remain stale. Consider also deleting duplicates in save handler.
crossborder OH bracket uses $26,050/0% then 2.75% then 3.5% top rate — matches 2024 OH schedule; good. Note: STATE_BRACKETS now diverges from STATE_FLAT so progression message is accurate.
/report/crossborder-pdf correctly 403s enterprise and 404s before save; nicely enforces 'Save first' UX contract.
